senses.gloss:
स्थूर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = स्थूल, स्थविर,
strong, firm; wide, extended, (Sāy. = विस्तृत, Ṛg-
veda VI. 29, 2); (अस्), m. a bull (Ved.); a man.

स्थूरिन्, ई, m. (also written स्थुरिन्, cf. स्थौ-
रिन्), a pack-horse, one carrying loads on his back;
a pack-bullock; (इ), n., Ved. a cart drawn by one
bull or draught animal, (Sāy. = एकेन धुर्येण
युक्तम् अनः, Ṛg-veda X. 131, 3); [cf. Zend
staora, ‘a beast of burden:’ Gr. ταῦρο-ς: Lat.
tauru-s: Umbr. turu: Old Germ. stiuri, ‘strong;’
stur, ‘large:’ Goth. stiur: Angl. Sax. steor, stor:
Engl. steer: Slav. turu, ‘a bull:’ Lith. taura-s,
‘a wild ox.’]
1. स्थुल in अप-ष्ठ्˚, वि-संष्ठ्˚, q. q. v. v.

स्थुल 2. स्थुल, अम्, n. (perhaps for स्थुड,
fr. rt. स्थुड्, but cf. 1. स्थुल at p. 1147, col. 3),
a sort of long tent.

स्थूल, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably a later form of
स्थूर for स्थावर, see p. 1147, col. 3), strong,
powerful; stout, bulky, big, huge; fat, corpulent;
great, large, thick; clumsy, coarse, gross, rough,
(opposed to सूक्ष्म); not exact; doltish, stolid,
thick-headed; stupid, dull, ignorant; (अस्), m. the
jack tree; (आ), f. a sort of pepper (= गज-पिप्पली);
a kind of gourd or cucumber (= एर्वारु); large
cardamoms; (अम्), n. a heap, quantity; = कूट
(according to Śabda-k.); a tent, (probably for
2. स्थुल.)
—स्थूल-कङ्गु, उस्, m. a sort of wild
and coarse kidney-bean (= वरक).
—स्थूल-कणा,
f. the plant Nigella Indica.
—स्थूल-कण्टक, अस्, m.
‘large-thorned,’ a kind of plant, = जाल-वर्वूरक;
(इका), f. the silk-cotton tree.
—स्थूल-कण्टा, f. a
kind of plant (= बृहती).
—स्थूल-कन्द, अस्, m.
‘having a large bulb,’ a kind of esculent root or
plant with such a root (= सूरण; = माणक; =
हस्ति-कन्द); a kind of garlic (= रक्त-लशुन).
—स्थूल-काय, अस्, आ, अम्, large-bodied, corpulent.
—स्थूल-काष्ठ-दह्, -धक्, or स्थूल-काष्-
ठाग्नि (˚ठ-अग्˚), इस्, m. the trunk of a tree or
[]
any thick piece of timber on fire.
—स्थूल-क्षेड
or स्थूल-क्ष्वेड, अस्, m. (see क्ष्वेड), an arrow.
—स्थूल-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, thick-necked.
—स्थू-
लङ्-करण, अस्, ई, अम्, making big or large.
—स्थूल-चञ्चु, उस्, m. a kind of culinary plant
(= महा-चञ्चु).
—स्थूल-चाप, अस्, m. (for तूल-
चाप), a large bow-like instrument used in cleaning
cotton.
—स्थूल-जीरक, अस्, m. the plant Nigella
Indica (called Kaloñjī in Hindī).
—स्थूल-तर, अस्,
आ, अम्, more bulky, bigger, stouter, very large,
larger.
—स्थूल-ता, f. or स्थूल-त्व, अम्, n. big-
ness, stoutness, bulkiness, coarseness; dulness, stu-
pidity.
—स्थूल-ताल, अस्, m. the marshy date tree
(= हिन्ताल).
—स्थूल-त्वचा, f. ‘thick-barked,’ a
kind of plant (= काश्मरी).
—स्थूल-दण्ड, अस्,
m. a sort of large reed (= देव-नल).
—स्थूल-
दर्भ, अस्, m. a kind of grass, Saccharum Munja.
—स्थूल-दला, f. the plant Aloe Perfoliata.
—स्थू-
ल-देह, अस्, अम्, m. n. = स्थूल-शरीर below.
—स्थूल-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, dull-witted, stupid, ignorant.
—स्थूल-नाल, अस्, m. a kind of large reed (=
देव-नल).
—स्थूल-नास or स्थूल-नासिक, अस्,
आ, अम्, large-nosed, thick-nosed; (अस्), m. a hog,
boar.
—स्थूल-पट, अस्, अम्, m. n. coarse cloth;
(अस्, आ, अम्), having coarse cloth or clothes.
—स्थूल-
पट्ट, अस्, m. cotton; (अम्), n. coarse cloth (accord-
ing to some).
—स्थूल-पट्टाक, अस्, m. coarse cloth.
—स्थूल-पाद, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, large-footed, club-
footed, having swelled legs; (अस्), m. an elephant;
a man with elephantiasis.
—स्थूल-पुष्प, अस्, m.
‘large-flowered,’ the tree Æschynomene Grandiflora;
(आ), f. a sort of mountain Clitorea; (ई), f. a kind
of plant (= यव-तिक्ता).
—स्थूल-फल, अम्, n.
the gross result of a calculation or measurement;
(अस्), m. ‘having large fruit,’ the silk-cotton tree;
(आ), f. the Crotolaria (= शण-पुष्पी).
—स्थूल-
बाहू, ऊस्, f., N. of a woman.
—स्थूल-बुद्धि, इस्,
इस्, इ, dull-witted, dull, stupid.
—स्थूल-भद्र,
अस्, m., N. of one of the six Jaina Śruta-kevalins.
—स्थूल-भूत, आनि, n. pl. the five grosser ele-
ments (according to the Sāṅkhya phil., see साङ्ख्य).
—स्थूल-मरिच, अम्, n. a particular fragrant berry
(= कक्कोल).
—स्थूल-मान, अम्, n. gross or
rough measure, rough computation.
—स्थूल-मूल,
अम्, n. a large root; a kind of radish (= चाणक्य-
मूलक).
—स्थूलम्-भविष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, or
स्थूलम्-भावुक, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming large or
stout.
—स्थूल-लक्ष or स्थूल-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, ‘having large aims or attributes,’ munificent,
liberal, generous; wise, learned; disposed to recol-
lect both benefits and injuries; taking careless aim.
—स्थूललक्ष्य-त्व, अम्, n. munificence, libe-
rality; aiming carelessly.
—स्थूल-वर्त्म-कृत्, त्,
m. a kind of shrub (= ब्राह्मण-यष्टिका).
—स्थूल-वल्कल, अस्, m. ‘thick-barked,’ the red
Lodhra (or Lodh tree, the bark of which is used in
tanning, &c.).
—स्थूल-वृक्ष-फल, अस्, m. a
kind of plant or tree (= स्निग्ध-पिण्डीतक).
—स्थूल-वैदेही, f. a particular plant (= गज-
पिप्पली).
—स्थूल-शङ्खा, f. a woman having a
large vulva.
—स्थूल-शर, अस्, m. a kind of large
reed.
—स्थूल-शरीर, अम्, n. the grosser or material
and perishable body with which a soul clad in its
subtile body is invested, (opposed to सूक्ष्म-
शरीर and लिङ्ग-शरीर, q. q. v. v.); (अस्, आ, अम्),
large-bodied, huge.
—स्थूल-शाटक, अस्, अका or
इका, m. f. or स्थूल-शाटि, इस्, m. thick or coarse
cloth.
—स्थूल-शालि, इस्, m. a kind of large rice.
—स्थूल-शिरस्, अस्, n. a large head or summit;
(आस्, आस्, अस्), large-headed.
—स्थूल-शीर्षक, अस्,
इका, अम्, large-headed; (इका), f. a small ant having
a large head in proportion to its size.
—स्थूल-षट्-
पद, अस्, m. a large bee; wasp.
—स्थूल-ष्ठीवि,
इस्, m., N. of the father of a grammarian.
—स्थूल-
सूक्ष्म, अस्, आ, अम्, mighty and subtile (as God
who sustains the universe and an atom).
—स्थूल-
स्कन्ध, अस्, m. ‘having a thick stem,’ the Lakuca
tree.
—स्थूल-हस्त, अस्, m. a large hand; the
thick trunk of an elephant; (अम्), n. an elephant's
trunk; (अस्, आ, अम्), having large hands.
—स्थू-
लांशा (˚ल-अं˚), f. a kind of Curcuma (= गन्ध-
[]
पत्त्रा).
—स्थूलान्त्र (˚ल-अन्˚), अम्, n. the larger
intestine near the anus.
—स्थूलाम्र (˚ल-आम्˚),
अस्, m. the large Mango tree (= महाराज-चूत).
—स्थूलास्य (˚ल-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, large-faced,
large-mouthed; (अस्), m. a snake.
—स्थूली-करण,
अम्, n. the act of making large or bulky, enlarging,
fattening.
—स्थूली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made large,
enlarged, fattened.
—स्थूली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, be-
come large or thick, become bulky, fattened.
—स्थू-
लैरण्ड (˚ल-एर्˚), अस्, m. the large castor-oil
plant.
—स्थूलैला (˚ल-एला), f. large cardamoms.
—स्थूलोच्चय (˚ल-उच्˚), अस्, m. ‘rough aggre-
gation,’ a large fragment of rock or crag fallen from
a mountain and forming an irregular mound or
hillock; incompleteness, deficiency, defect; the
middle pace of elephants (neither quick nor slow);
an eruption of pimples on the face; a hollow at the
root of an elephant's tusks.

स्थूरिका, f. (probably) a barren cow, (according
to some this is the more correct reading for छूरिका
in Manu VIII. 325.)

स्थुड् स्थुड् = rt. थुड्, cl. 6. P. स्थुडति,
&c., to cover.

स्थूम स्थूम, अस्, m. (according to Śabda-k.)
light; the moon; [cf. स्यूम.]

स्थूल् स्थूल् (rather a Nom. derived fr.
स्थूल below), cl. 10. A. स्थूलयते
(also P. स्थूलयति according to some), अतुस्थूलत्,
त, to become big or stout, to become bulky, in-
crease, grow fat.

स्थूलक, अस्, आ, अम्, large, bulky; (अस्), m. a
sort of grass or reed (Saccharum Cylindricum, com-
monly called Ulu).
स्थूलिन्, ई, m. a camel; [cf. स्थूरिन्.]
